author: The Infographics Show
description:
What would it actually look like if artificial intelligence became an existential threat to humanity? Probably nothing like the movies.

This video explores 10 possible pathways by which increasingly autonomous AI systems could create catastrophic risks over the next decade. From critical infrastructure failures and AI-powered cyber warfare to deceptive models, automation bias, and systems capable of improving themselves faster than humans can understand them.
As businesses hand more responsibility to AI, another danger emerges. Human expertise begins to disappear. If automated logistics, financial networks, power grids, healthcare systems, or military defenses suddenly fail, there may no longer be enough experienced people left to take control manually.
